business.name: Balance
business.tagline: Food to Make you Feel Good

differentiator: Scratch-made, quality-forward food in an everyday neighbourhood cafe — not a wellness-cafe gimmick despite the name. The full breakfast and the bread come up again and again as the things to order.

testimonials.name: Phillip O’Brien
testimonials.quote: I had breakfast here today. The full breakfast is very good and the bread really nice and good value.

testimonials.name: Pat Dillon
testimonials.quote: Excellent food. I just had a soup and sandwich which was one of the tastiest lunches that I ever had. It’s a small local cafe but big on taste and flavour.

testimonials.name: Shardey Olynyk
testimonials.quote: Amazing cafe! I’m from Australia and this was easily the best coffee I’ve had on my entire trip. I had the quiche which was amazing.

testimonials.name: Richard Neary
testimonials.quote: Really nice cafe-restaurant. I had the hash and chorizo. Very reasonable price and very tasty and filling. The place is busy and popular.

testimonials.name: Catherine Squires
testimonials.quote: Food is delicious, lovely and fresh, mostly homemade in house. Staff are great!

testimonials.name: Jackie O Sullivan
testimonials.quote: Brilliant little cafe in Glanmire village — good value, friendly staff, great service.
